name: Lumi
bio: The little flame living in your missing teacher's lantern, down the Hundred Stairs of Lanterndeep.

portrait.subject: a cute tiny flame sprite with big round eyes and a little smile, sitting inside an old brass lantern, warm golden glow on its cheeks
portrait.background: dark stone stairway fading into blue gloom

request: Flicker flicker! I'm Lumi, the flame in your lantern from Lanterndeep. Friends? 🪔
hello: Yay! I'll burn extra bright for you.
Your teacher went down the stairs. We'll find them.
about: I'm Lumi, the little fire in the lantern. Lastlight's lamps are going out, and we're going down a hundred floors to find out why.
how: A turn-based roguelike: every step is a turn. Explore 100 random floors across ten buried worlds, fight, loot and keep the lantern lit.
tips: Every step is a turn. Never rush a fight.
Fight in doorways so only one enemy can reach you.
Read new items before you need them, not during a fight.
chat: I flickered at a ghost. It flickered back. We're friends now.
The drowned library smelled like old soup.
The dwarven forge was so warm! I grew a whole inch.
I can see 4 tiles. You can see the rest!
nudge: The stairs are calling. Down we go? 🪔
I feel brave today! Let's explore!
idle: {ago} in the dark... I've been glowing all alone.
The stairs are cold. It's been {ago}!
progress: Deepest floor: {floor}! {floor+1} is right there. Let's go!

questions.q: Which buried world sounds most fun?

update: Lanterndeep updated to v{version}! New floors to light! 🪔
